title: sophora tomentosa f. polyphylla
intro: Sophora tomentosa f. polyphylla, commonly known as Ke gong or Korean sophora, is a plant species in the legume family. It has been traditionally used in East Asian medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as immune system modulation. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-cancer, anti-bacterial, and anti-viral activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These compounds have been shown to exhibit anti-proliferative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making Sophora tomentosa f. polyphylla a promising natural remedy for various diseases.
